label: Build an object
description: Build one JSON object from wired values (a reply body, a request body): each input becomes a key of the same name, in written order, so `job: open.id` beside `status: "running"` is `{"job": "...", "status": "running"}`. Nest by wiring another JsonObject's `object` onto a key. Keys are required, so a closed branch skips the node; a key written `key?:` is left out (not null) when nothing arrives, and with every key optional and none arriving the object is `{}`. A node whose keys are all optional needs its `_should_flow` wired to what must have happened (`body._should_flow = route.fired`).

outputs.name: object
outputs.description: The object, keyed by input name in written order. Declare its type to have it held to a record (`-> (object: Signup)`): an object that does not fit fails the node naming the field.

then.message: JsonObject '{id}' has no keys, so there is nothing to build. Wire a value onto it for each key you want, naming the key.
